verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no first-party documentation of an OpenAPI/Swagger spec for Better Auth's generated endpoints, and a direct probe of common OpenAPI spec paths (openapi.json, swagger.json, etc.) returned 404 across the board. While Better Auth exposes machine-readable llms.txt/docs.md content and an MCP server for docs/setup help, neither constitutes a machine-readable API spec of its auth endpoints.
